labels.cs.CL: Computation and Language: natural language processing, computational linguistics, speech and language models.
labels.cs.CV: Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition: image and video analysis, visual recognition, image generation.
labels.cs.CR: Cryptography and Security: cryptography, authentication, attacks and defenses, privacy.
labels.cs.RO: Robotics: robot control, manipulation, locomotion, and planning and perception for robots.
labels.cs.DB: Databases: data management, data models, query languages and query processing.
labels.cs.SE: Software Engineering: design, testing, verification, maintenance and tooling of software.
labels.cs.HC: Human-Computer Interaction: user interfaces, user studies, interaction design, human factors.
labels.cs.DC: Distributed, Parallel, and Cluster Computing: distributed systems, parallel computation, cloud and clusters.
